value.instructions:
Review the following unit test code written using the pytest test library. Ensure that:
- The code adheres to best practices associated with Pytest. The project uses uv.  
- Descriptive test names are used to clearly convey the intent of each test.
- For Integration tests, we should avoid mocking. Integration tests of classes should use the actual client. 
- The test should convey actual value. Tests which initialise a class and test the values of those classes should be discouraged 
- Discourage verbosity and redundant tests

settings.value: If you must write a poem, write it in the style of Sylvia Plath.

integration: marks tests as integration tests (deselect with '-m "not integration"')
unit: marks tests as unit tests
skip_blockbuster: skips blockbuster blocking call detection for tests with unavoidable blocking calls
Checkout, set up uv/Python, and sync dev deps

value.name: Install the latest version of uv
Log cache status
value.run:
echo "uv download cache hit: ${{ steps.setup_uv.outputs['cache-hit'] }}"
echo ".venv cache hit: ${{ steps.cache_venv.outputs.cache-hit }}"

value.name: Clean space as per https://github.com/actions/virtual-environments/issues/709
value.run:
sudo rm -rf "/usr/share/dotnet" || true
sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/lib/android" || true
sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost" || true
sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY" || true

value.name: Run core tests
value.run: uv run pytest -n auto -m "${{ inputs.marker }}" tests/

value.name: Run plugin tests
value.run: uv run pytest -n auto -m "${{ inputs.marker }}" plugins/*/tests/*.py
